description: splits items into reproducible train and test sets using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded seeded train test split result when an agent needs a reproducible decision that another run can independently replay. Returns the deterministic selection plus seed provenance, population bounds, and the operation-specific outcome for Seeded Train Test Split as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Uses Python pseudorandomness for reproducibility, not cryptography, lotteries with value, security tokens, gambling, or custody.

items.description: Items supplied to Seeded Train Test Split; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

seed.description: Seed supplied to Seeded Train Test Split; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

test_fraction.description: Test Fraction supplied to Seeded Train Test Split; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.
